text:
Maya: Quick design review — dropping the latest catalog mock. Two things I want input on: fuzzy search behavior (placeholder microcopy & matches) and where to place the performance badge/pill so it feels clearly tied to the model. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.mock/snap1.png

Ravi: Looks great overall. For fuzzy search: surface exact matches first, then fuzzy results. Highlight the matching token in the name/tag. Shortcut suggestion: `/` focuses search. :mag:

Jon: Perf pill placement — I prefer it left, next to the model name, so users associate it with the model instead of a metrics column. Right-side pills read like table metadata. Small dot + color for status sounds ok.

Priya: A11y note: current perf pill contrast is ~2.8:1, we need 4.5:1 for body text. Also add aria-labels like `aria-label="P99 latency 120ms"` so screen readers can read metric and units.

Carmen: Copy nit: the label "Perf" is ambiguous. Recommend explicit labels: "P99 latency" or "Avg latency" depending on what we show. Default the catalog to P99.

Maya: Agreed on P99. For the search placeholder I'm thinking: "Try model name, task, or tag" — keeps it discoverable. Also want filter chips to have a 44px touch target and a clear 'x' hit area.

Ravi: On version UX: instead of immediately showing a pinned state, show a lightweight "snapshot: 2024-05-02 14:21" inline and expose a pin icon only when users click the snapshot. Default action = view latest.

Jon: Small table/compare UX nit — keep the compare checkbox column sticky on the left so when users sort or expand rows the checkboxes don't shift. Also avoid hiding the checkboxes behind hover states.

Priya: Compare modal accessibility: use role="dialog", trap focus, and set `aria-describedby` to an element with quick instructions (e.g., "Select up to 3 models to compare"). Also ensure keyboard support for the compare keyboard flow.

Maya: Thanks — that's actionable. Quick design question: perf pill color scale — use semantic green/orange/red or neutral background + icon?

Carmen: Use semantic colors + icon, but provide a neutral-outline alternative for high-contrast mode. Also include a tooltip with exact numbers on hover and an accessible tooltip for keyboard users.

design-bot: Reminder: product guideline 3.2 requires 44px touch targets on chips/buttons and clear focus outlines for keyboard nav.

Maya: I'll update the mock with: P99 label, perf pill moved left of name, new search placeholder, and a11y fixes. Will push SVGs + tokens later today and ping @Ravi @Priya for the final accessibility pass. :thumbsup:
